responsibility: Implements the AVX10.2 conversion intrinsic header for 128-bit and 256-bit FP16/BF8/HF8 data movement and format conversion. It owns the narrow-width APIs for combining two FP32 vectors into FP16, converting FP16 to and from BF8 or HF8 encodings, and handling biased or signed variants, with masking and rounding controls where the ISA supports them.
